title: pauseWithdraw silently forfeits accrued phUSD and stable rewards proportional to amount withdrawn (no pre-claim, no event signalling forfeiture)
rootCause: `pauseWithdraw` reduces `user.amount` and `totalStaked` but does not call `_updatePool` or `_claimRewards`, and does not rebase `user.{phUSD,stable}Debt`. Subsequent reward calculation uses the reduced `amount` -- so the user's pending rewards earned against the pre-withdraw amount are discarded, with no event indicating it. The only emitted event is the generic `EmergencyWithdrawal(user, amount)` which carries no reward-related signal.
impact: User-visible loss of accrued rewards each time they pause-withdraw, beyond what the 'emergency exit' phrasing implies. The user may rationally assume that, because the contract has not paid the rewards out, they can claim later -- but in practice the debts go stale and either (a) silently truncate (the lucky case) or (b) revert the entire claim path (CODE-002, the unlucky case). Either way the user has less reward than they earned, and there is no telemetry to let off-chain tooling reconcile.
attackVector: No attacker. Honest user trying to escape during a pause loses pending rewards. Repeated pauses (a pauser flipping the contract often) compound the loss because every pause-window cycle requires the user to either accept reward loss (pauseWithdraw) or skip the escape and risk further loss.
steps: User stake = 100e18; rewards accrue over time; pendingPhUSD = X > 0, pendingStable = Y > 0.
user.pauseWithdraw(100e18) -- user.amount = 0; debts unchanged; user receives 100e18 phUSD principal only.
Event log shows only EmergencyWithdrawal(user, 100e18). No event records that X phUSD and Y rewardToken pending were forfeited.

If user re-stakes later, the stale debts (relative to fresh amount=0 -> debt=0 on re-stake via the user.amount += amount path) get re-initialized correctly, but the previously accrued rewards are gone.
remediation: Either (a) call `_updatePool` and `_claimRewards` (or at least record the forfeited amount in a `Forfeited(user, phUSDAmount, rewardAmount)` event) before reducing `user.amount`; (b) rebase debts proportionally so the user still claims the rewards earned on the un-withdrawn share; (c) document the forfeiture loudly in natspec and emit the forfeited amounts in `EmergencyWithdrawal`. Option (a) or (b) also fixes CODE-002 / CODE-007. Option (c) at minimum makes the loss explicit.
profileReference: Profile §4.3 pauseWithdraw 'Implication: pending rewards (both phUSD and stable) are forfeited proportional to the amount withdrawn ... No event for the implicit reward forfeiture beyond the EmergencyWithdrawal event.'
